caveats: Cycles are those of the Verilator model of the RTL at the base commit; zba_bench is a deliberately dense address-generation workload, the best case rather than a typical program.
Image bytes are the size of out.bin (code, read-only and initialised data), not of .text alone.
zba_arr CYCLES includes waiting for the UART inside its timed window and is not a speed figure.

The program images (init.mem) are byte-identical to those built by the build script of 2026-08-18; run on a simulator built from 1f501f5 they print the same lines (see results/zba/2026-08-18_1f501f5).
The ELF files are reproducible bit for bit; logs/ holds the run log of each program with colour codes removed.

The fingerprints under inputs are those of the files the run used (Makefile sha256 1dcbe87eb8bef2f178223568dff041ee1e5a2dcb5ff1ed7ec5dd30de42be28ff, without the check-results target). Files that changed afterwards, before they were committed, are listed with their new sha256 in rechecked.sha256, with which make check-results reproduced this record exactly. Correction (2026-10-01): the Makefile fingerprint had been changed to that of the extended file (2cd15d508f09973d61d90e439fcb9f58f72b723e31c5bbaa0f5c17ca1bdc834a); it again names the file the run used.
